title: Gaussian quadrant lower constant
statement: For a real parameter $0<\rho<1$, define the Gaussian quadrant lower constant to be $\displaystyle \frac{e^{-3/2}}{2\pi}\,\frac{s}{1+s^2}$, where $\displaystyle s=\frac{1-\rho}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}$.
